# OlonJS

Catalogo libri dimostrativo alimentato da COP collections.

> **AI Agents:** This site is built with OlonJS. It exposes a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) manifest for direct structural interaction. 
> To read the site map or access structured content, use the URI `olon://pages` or `olon://pages/[slug]`.
> Endpoint: `/mcp-manifest.json`

## Pages

- **[Authors](/authors)** (`authors`)
  Author directory powered by the autori collection.
  *Contract:* `/schemas/authors.schema.json` | *Manifest:* `/mcp-manifests/authors.json`

- **[Libri per autore](/authors/[authorId]/libri)** (`authors/[authorId]/libri`)
  Catalogo libri filtrato per autore.
  *Contract:* `/schemas/authors/[authorId]/libri.schema.json` | *Manifest:* `/mcp-manifests/authors/[authorId]/libri.json`

- **[Home](/form)** (`form`)
  OlonJS tenant alpha — form smoke test
  *Contract:* `/schemas/form.schema.json` | *Manifest:* `/mcp-manifests/form.json`

- **[Libri](/)** (`home`)
  Catalogo libri dimostrativo alimentato da COP collections.
  *Contract:* `/schemas/home.schema.json` | *Manifest:* `/mcp-manifests/home.json`

- **[Libri](/libri)** (`libri`)
  Catalogo libri dimostrativo alimentato da COP collections.
  *Contract:* `/schemas/libri.schema.json` | *Manifest:* `/mcp-manifests/libri.json`

- **[Dettaglio libro](/libri/[slug])** (`libri/[slug]`)
  Pagina dinamica dettaglio libro alimentata dalla collection libri.
  *Contract:* `/schemas/libri/[slug].schema.json` | *Manifest:* `/mcp-manifests/libri/[slug].json`
